data.title: Bitcoin Usually Bottoms After Midterm Elections. What Happens if This Cycle Breaks the Pattern?
data.description: For three straight election cycles, Bitcoin found its floor within weeks of midterm voting. This year the pattern shattered, but whether that means the worst is already over or a deeper drop still looms depends on one critical price level.
